reputation_pointer._doc: The typed pointer field proposed on a2aproject/A2A#1962 (issuer/scheme/ref, verifying key + anchored committed_at, content-addressed export with monotonic head commitment, published head location, explicit genesis marker) mapped onto a real, live invinoveritas /ledger entry -- not a hypothetical schema.
reputation_pointer.committed_at_meaning: Bitcoin OTS block time -- this record's signed event_id was stamped into a Bitcoin block, precedence=true (committed before any outcome was known), independently checkable via `ots verify`.

genesis_marker.why: entries #1-39 predate the head-chaining fix and keep their original individual OTS anchors, unchanged (not retroactively chained -- rewriting history into a chain would invalidate their existing signatures). Entry #40 is the documented root the chain starts from -- the CHAIN_START_ENTRY-equivalent named in the original proposal.
